### Executive Summary

Customers of eco-product retailer Who Gives A Crap have been impacted by a data breach stemming from a cyberattack against a third-party service provider, according to a report by 7NEWS. 

The overall extent of the exposure, the specific third-party vendor involved, and the exact timeline of the incident have not yet been confirmed based on the available reporting.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause

The root cause of the incident involves a supply-chain security compromise originating at an external third-party service provider rather than a direct breach of Who Gives A Crap's core infrastructure. 

The full technical impact—including the precise categories of customer data exposed or accessed during the third-party breach—remains unverified. Further details regarding vendor access levels and system exposure are not yet confirmed.

### Mitigation & IOCs

Specific vendor-recommended mitigations and remediation steps have not been disclosed in the provided source material. Organizations monitoring supply-chain risks are advised to audit third-party vendor permissions and maintain vigilance against potential secondary phishing attempts targeting customers.
